# BuildQueueManager

> **File:** `services/core/BuildQueueManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Spreads building UI over frames: a page's modules (ModuleGrid.stream) and tool pages' sections (StreamedLoader) queue a job each, and the jobs run a few per 16 ms step, within a 6 ms budget (at least one a step, however long it takes), so showing a page never waits on all of it. Jobs run in the order queued, those whose owner is visible first (the page shown before its neighbours). A job that alone takes over a frame is logged (`--debug`), naming its label.

### Properties

- `pending` (readonly int): Jobs still waiting

### Functions

- `request(owner, job, label)`: Queues `job` (a function building something) for `owner` (an Item; its jobs are dropped when it cancels)
- `cancel(owner)`: Drops `owner`'s jobs not run yet: call it from onDestruction
